_comment: Disruptions recorded by hand from an operator's or council's own notice, because none of this area's operators or councils publish to the BODS disruptions feed. Each entry keeps the author's words, the page it came from and the date it was checked. Add one with scripts/add_disruption.py; see docs/RUNBOOK.md, 'Adding a disruption'. Entries past their end date stop showing on their own; `add_disruption.py --prune` removes them.

disruptions.summary: Western Road closed between Holland Road and Montpelier Road
disruptions.description: Due to roadworks on Western Road, we will be unable to serve all stops between Waitrose and Palmeira Square. All Routes except 1X, 2 and 46 towards Hove will be on diversion via Montpelier Road, Davigdor Road and Holland Road to resume full route from Palmeira Square. Routes 1X, 2 and 46 will be on diversion via Montpelier Road, Montpelier Place and Holland Road to resume full route from Palmeira Square. Route 71A, is only affected in 1 direction towards Mile Oak. All routes towards Brighton will be on diversion via Holland Road, Lansdowne Road and Montpelier Road to resume full route from Waitrose. All stops on the diversion routes will be served.
disruptions.advice: Please allow extra time for travelling during these times.
disruptions.notes: Stagecoach's Coastliner 700 and N700 also use this stretch and are timetabled at Brunswick Place and Norfolk Square. They are not in this Brighton & Hove Buses notice, but the stops are on the closed road, so no bus can call at them.

disruptions.summary: Western Road closed between Holland Road and Montpelier Road
disruptions.description: On 28 of September we will close Western Road between Holland Road and Montpelier Road for 45 days. Bus diversion westbound: Waitrose on Western Road, right onto Montpelier Road, around 7 dials, along Goldmids and Davigdor Road, left down Holland Road, right to rejoin Western Road for Palmeira Square bus stop. Bus diversion eastbound: Palmeria Square, left onto Holland Road, right onto Landsdowne Road, right onto Montpelier Road, left back onto Western Road for the Waitrose bus stop.
disruptions.advice: Brunswick Place and Norfolk Square are not served. Use Palmeira Square or Waitrose instead.
disruptions.notes: The council's notice names no operator. Stagecoach has published no notice of its own; the 700 has run this diversion since 28 September (measured from its tracked buses), and Brunswick Place and Norfolk Square are on the closed road.

disruptions.summary: Old Steine roadworks: southbound buses diverted via Edward Street, Rock Gardens and the seafront
disruptions.description: Due to roadworks at the Old Steine, all Southbound services will be on diversion via Edward Street, Rock Gardens and the seafront. During this time, routes 25/25X, and 78 will be unable to serve the Old Steine between 07:00-18:00 each day. Passengers are advised to use Valley Gardens. Routes 77 are using North Street, then on to St James Street to loop round to the pier and return to the normal route. All coastal routes, and the 79 route will be unable to serve North Street towards Eastbourne during this time. Please use the North Road or Sealife Centre bus stops during this time. Routes 1, 1X, 7 and 2 when operating Westbound only will be unable to serve the following stops: -Devonshire Place -Law Courts Brighton. Please use: Park Street or Old Steine (stop S1) Routes towards Imperial 5B,20,21,22,24,26, and 29, towards Imperial Archard will be diverting via Grand Parade, right up to Church Street, into Spring Gardens, North Road, Queens Road to Imperial Arcade, and Churchill square. Stops not being served: Old Steine (Stop S3), Old Steine (Stop S2), Old Steine (stop S1), Royal Pavilion, North Street. Please use: Valley Gardens, Imperial Arcade, Churchill Square. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.
disruptions.advice: Please use Valley Gardens, Imperial Arcade or Churchill Square.
disruptions.notes: Compass (52) and Metrobus (271, 272) share Brighton & Hove Buses' service updates, so this notice is theirs too. Old Steine Stop S4 is the notice's 'Old Steine S-bound': every bus through it is southbound, so the diversion takes them all off it. What each group of routes does differently is recorded as its own entry, with this one as its parent.

disruptions.summary: Routes 25, 25X and 78 not serving the Old Steine, 07:00 to 18:00
disruptions.description: During this time, routes 25/25X, and 78 will be unable to serve the Old Steine between 07:00-18:00 each day. Passengers are advised to use Valley Gardens.

disruptions.summary: Routes towards Imperial Arcade diverted via Grand Parade, Church Street and North Road
disruptions.description: Routes towards Imperial 5B,20,21,22,24,26, and 29, towards Imperial Archard will be diverting via Grand Parade, right up to Church Street, into Spring Gardens, North Road, Queens Road to Imperial Arcade, and Churchill square. Stops not being served: Old Steine (Stop S3), Old Steine (Stop S2), Old Steine (stop S1), Royal Pavilion, North Street. Please use: Valley Gardens, Imperial Arcade, Churchill Square.
disruptions.advice: Please use Valley Gardens, Imperial Arcade or Churchill Square.
disruptions.notes: Only journeys that call at Imperial Arcade (Stop C7), so the same routes the other way are untouched. 28, 29A and 48 are not named in this line but are in the notice's route list and run the same way to Imperial Arcade, through Old Steine Stop S2 and North Street Stop N7, so they are taken to divert with the others.

disruptions.advice: Please use the North Road or Sealife Centre bus stops.

disruptions.summary: Old Steine roadworks: after Churchill Square, the 700 diverts to Brighton Station
disruptions.description: Stagecoach has published no notice for the 700. During the Old Steine roadworks, buses towards Brighton have been seen turning left after Churchill Square up Queens Road to Brighton Station, turning there, and coming back down to Churchill Square as the service towards Worthing. They do not reach North Street or the Old Steine.
disruptions.advice: Board or leave the 700 at Churchill Square.
disruptions.notes: Reported by a rider on 24 October 2026, not from a notice and not yet checked against tracked buses; Stagecoach's service updates page listed nothing for the 700 that day. The N700 is left out: nobody has said what it does.
